meta.title: Word Morph Lab
meta.subtitle: Type a word and push a locked anime portrait into a new visual state.
meta.description: Prototype catalog for 100 keyword-driven image states. The catalog is tuned for a single recurring heroine rendered as a bust portrait with stable lineart and cel shading.
meta.base_prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, bust portrait, centered composition, looking at viewer, clean anime lineart, crisp cel shading, soft studio backdrop, stable face, stable hairstyle, expressive eyes, high detail face, consistent character design
meta.negative_prompt: low quality, worst quality, blurry, realistic, painterly, 3d, text, watermark, multiple views, cropped, extra arms, extra hands, extra fingers, duplicate body, deformed face, bad anatomy, child, loli, toddler, baby
style_lock_notes: Keep one recurring heroine and change only one fantasy axis per word.
Use reference guidance only after a base face has been approved.
Cache accepted results and reuse them instead of regenerating on repeat input.
